title: A merchant-issued refund on a loan NOT charged off posts ONE 10.00 credit to OVERPAYMENT 16 and ONE 10.00 debit to the resolved fund source 10 (loan 9 L55, overpayment-only)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a MERCHANT-ISSUED REFUND posted on a loan NOT charged off under the SAME method as an ordinary repayment, createJournalEntriesForLoanRepayments (dispatch: isRepaymentType() includes isMerchantIssuedRefund() [LoanTransactionType.java:193-196]; AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan.java:87-90 then :1369-1376; pinned 426a23544). Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_ADV_CUSTOM_PMT_ALLOC_PROGRESSIVE_LOAN_SCHEDULE_HORIZONTAL, loan 9 chargedOff false / fraud false) at merchantIssuedRefund transaction L55. request.repayment_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's transaction id 55 (type loanTransactionType.merchantIssuedRefund id 21, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 8 AUTOPAY, manuallyReversed false): overpaymentPortion 10.0 -> "1000" minor units, principal/interest/fee/penalty 0 and omitted. request.repayment_journal.accounts is the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP2_ADV_CUSTOM_PMT_ALLOC_PROGRESSIVE_LOAN_SCHEDULE_HORIZONTAL.json with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel: loanPortfolioAccountId 7, receivableInterest/Fee/PenaltyAccountId 4, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 16, fundSourceAccountId 10; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 18, so the refund's paymentType 8 (AUTOPAY) has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 10. The vector supplies the RESOLVED account; the port does not resolve channels. expect.repayment_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L55 legs in id order from the journal-entries SWEEP: leg id 146 CREDIT glAccountId 16 10.00, leg id 147 DEBIT glAccountId 10 10.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a repayment-type posting CREDITS each non-zero portion to its slot account, MERGING portions that share a credit account at the first slot's position, then DEBITs the total exactly ONCE to the resolved fund source, credits first and the single debit last. A port that credits the wrong slot account or debits an account other than the resolved fund source moves a leg. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the merge discriminator (there is a single credited portion, so merging is invisible; the loan-1 interest+penalty merge vector grades it); the one-debit-vs-debit-per-portion discriminator (with one credit the two postings coincide; the loan-15 and loan-1 vectors carry more than one credit); the transaction-type dispatch itself (the seam carries no transaction type, so the merchant-issued kind is established by the capture, not by an input the port branches on). Every leg in the sweep file for L55 is transcribed; the ids are the observed posting ids and no reversed mirror leg is present. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
